generation_parameters.prompt: Make a 6-column x 4-row transparent orthographic pixel-art atlas for the four supplied dungeon terrain tiles. Columns exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Rows exactly sand-floor, lava-floor, water-puddle, oil-puddle matching references. Each cell one complete same tile/material, centered with consistent footprint. True orthographic views: front edge view, top straight down showing original tile pattern, right/left side, bottom underside, rear opposite front. Preserve each material and signature colors. No ground plane or shadows beyond the object, no scenery, labels, perspective, border, or cell marks. Crisp game pixel art. Infer hidden surfaces from each tile; transparent background.

provenance.notes: Unmodified raw generation retained for review and reproducibility.
